includeMeaning: Rendered cc1 token order only; no claim of effective header search precedence or equivalent compilation behavior

lexer.controls: reject NUL, ESC and other C0 controls except LF and horizontal tab; reject DEL
lexer.negativeDiagnostic: exactly one whole-line frozen synthetic-path invalid-linker diagnostic, consumed as a typed error at a record boundary, never deleted from raw evidence
lexer.records: four exact header lines then two POSIX-shlex job lines; ASCII-whitespace-only blank lines may be skipped
lexer.unexpectedText: reject; no ignored diagnostics, helper lines, response files or unknown tokens

linkerNegative.allOtherUnits: same ordered linkerPositive units; change supplier only

multiplicities.mode: exact full sequence, no generic last-option-wins or duplicate suppression
multiplicities.vendorFeatures: six exact joined literals once each at declared positions; no wildcard
multiplicities.warnings: each exact literal/value in orderedUnits once; any other -W token rejected

pathPolicy: literal lexical comparison; no resolve/normalization, aliases, dot components, extra inputs or independent object paths
proposedRuntimeModule: separate v2 parser; keep all existing parsers/executors/validators byte-for-byte unchanged

semanticBoundary.knownSemanticFlags: retain exact values; never ignore or rewrite
semanticBoundary.opaqueAppleTokens: request explicit review acceptance for exact observed spellings in planning-only classifier; no harmlessness/codegen equivalence claim
semanticBoundary.unresolvedCompilerSemantics: blocking for C++/runtime qualification, not silently waived by diagnostic replay

slots.ATTEMPT: single exact canonical absolute fresh path from a separately reviewed future execution freeze; historical sample never reused for native work

OBJECT.ruleSource: existing v1 bounded object-name rule; no inference about random suffix algorithm

slots.SYNTHETIC_TARGET: exact identity-pinned marker path/receipt in separately reviewed freeze; never real ld; not OS-enforced immutable
